title: Fulfillment
description:
The `Fulfillment` model encapsulates the details of processing and delivering orders in an eCommerce context. It includes information such as fulfillment status, shipment tracking, the items to be fulfilled, and so on.
[url](../../docs/common_scenarios/tracking/bopis.md)

id.description: The unique identifier of the fulfillment. If a custom ID was provided in the request, that value is used; otherwise, a system-generated UUID is assigned. You can use this ID to manage this resource in related API calls.

order_id.description: It should be the same as the `order.id` of the `Order` resource.

delivery_method.description:
Delivery method of the order. For BOPIS related feature, please specify `pickup`.

For more information about pickup order, please check the detailed [BOPIS introduction page](../../docs/common_scenarios/tracking/bopis.md).

status.description:
The status of the fulfillment. Depending of on the `delivery_method`, the allowed values are different.

Allowed values: 

delivery_method is shipping:
`pending`, `processing`, `shipped`, `canceled`, and the custom defined statuses.

delivery_method is pickup:
`pending`, `processing`, `ready_for_pickup`, `picked_up`, `canceled`, and the custom defined statuses.

line_items.description: The items which included in this fulifllment.

id.description:
A unique identifier for the line item in your system. The value should be exist in one of the items in the corresponding order.

Note that it should be the same as the `order.items.*.id` of the `Order` resource.

product_id.description:
The ID of the product in your system.

Note that it should be the same as the `product.id` of the `Product` resource.

product_variant_id.description:
The ID of the product variant in source system.

Note that it should be the same as the `product.variants.id` of the `Product` resource.

product_variant_title.description: The title of the product variant.

quantity.description: The number of items in this fulfillment.

unit_price.description: The price of the item before discounts and taxes have been applied.

image_urls.description: Image urls of this product variant.

source_created_at.description: The date and time, formatted in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601), indicating when the fulfillment was created in your e-commerce system.

source_updated_at.description: The date and time, formatted in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601), indicating when the fulfillment was updated in your e-commerce system.

created_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the fulfillment was created in AfterShip.

updated_at.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 format) when the fulfillment was updated in AfterShip.

ship_from_location.description: The location information where the fulfillment shipped from.

location_id.description: The unique identifier for the location, as provided by AfterShip. You can manage and configure these locations [here](https://organization.automizely.com/warehouses).

address.description: The address object of this location.

pickup_location.description: The location information where the fulfillment is designated to be pickup from.

trackings.description: The shipment information of the fulfillment.

pickup_info.description: The pickup information of the fulfillment.

Address_with_coordinate.v1.description: The physical address and contact information of the location. For Location resources, `first_name` and `last_name` are joined into one contact name on write; on read, the full contact name is returned as `first_name` and `last_name` is empty. The `type` field is accepted by the schema but not used for Location resources — omit it on write; on read it is always empty.

Opening_hour_period.v1.title: OpeningHourPeriod
Opening_hour_period.v1.description: The `OpeningHourPeriod` model provides detailed information about a location's operating hours for a specific day. It includes the start and end times, and indicates whether the location is open on that particular day.

open.description: Indicate whether the store is open on this day. For locations that operate 24 hours, please set the value to `true`.

from.description: The start time of the opening hour period in YY:MM format. For locations that operate 24 hours, please set the value to `null`.

to.description: The end time of the opening hour period in YY:MM format. For locations that operate 24 hours, please set the value to `null`.

Opening_hours.v1.description: The regular opening hours of the location.
Opening_hours.v1.title: OpeningHours

Pickup.v1.description:
To indicate the detailed pickup instruction of the order when the delivery method of the order is `pickup`.

For further details on pickup / BOPIS orders, refer to our comprehensive [BOPIS introduction page](../docs/common_scenarios/tracking/bopis.md).
Pickup.v1.title: Pickup

instructions.description:
Instructions for the pickup process.

The value specified in this field will take precedence if provided through the API. If not specified, it will default to the pickup location's instructions set in the AfterShip Admin Portal.

estimated_ready_for_pickup_at.description:
The expected date and time when the items in this fulfillment order will be ready for pickup.

This information will be displayed on the Brand Tracking Page and included in customer notifications.

min.description: The earliest anticipated date and time, formatted in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

max.description: The latest anticipated date and time, formatted in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

pickup_deadline_at.description:
The latest time by which the pickup must be completed, formatted in [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

This information will be displayed on the Brand Tracking Page.

Pickup_location.v1.description: The location information where the fulfillment is designated to be pickup from. Mandatory when the delivery method of the fulfillment is `pickup`.
Pickup_location.v1.title: PickupLocation

location_id.description: The unique identifier for the address. You can find or create the corresponding value [here](https://organization.automizely.com/warehouses).

opening_hours.description: Opening hours information of the pickup location.

Tracking.v1.title: Tracking
Tracking.v1.description: Represents shipment tracking information. This object supports two mutually exclusive usage patterns: Reference Mode: Pass the tracking ID which created via the Tracking API. This enables full tracking capabilities. Inline Mode: Pass the tracking_number (and optional slug) directly. This is strictly for record-keeping purposes and does not create an active tracking task, and hence AfterShip system would not provide status updates to this tracking number.

id.description: The unique identifier of a tracking resource previously created via the Tracking API.

slug.description: Unique courier code. For a complete list of available courier codes, click here.

Weight.v1.description: The unit weight of the item.
Weight.v1.title: Weight

unit.description: The weight unit eg: g or kg.
